instance_premises: A Product adopts the graph-native profile and supplies its selected outcome and domain meanings.
Workers may change the workspace; the bound runtime admits evidence and governs traversal, leaving outcome, observation, admission and continuation distinct.

policy_choices: This profile chooses graph functions, typed assets, a published catalog/GTL module and a cumulative environment. Product semantics and the concrete GTL/ABG realization stay consumer-owned; environment declarations retain their stated `should` force.

This profile chooses the four functions and ABG admission/traversal divide. A consumer binds each function's inputs, outputs and grants; shared libraries, query access and actor reuse confer no additional operation.

This profile chooses `TargetObligationBinding`, published-action selection and graph-owned re-entry. Product authority owns outcome changes and bounded prerequisite/experiment admission; a reprice request supplies neither.

This profile requires reachable admitted ledger/event support, projection reconciliation and replay-visible decisions. Its evaluator consumes the admitted snapshot, so affected observations and uncertainty enter that support before dependent reliance. Ledger/replay architecture is an ODD policy, not a universal consequence of finite context.

This profile chooses seven closure dispositions, typed no-action and replay-visible yield. A8 binds their decision predicates separately from fitness; core conjunction retains known failure, uncertainty, performance and effects. Yield adds no failure classification of its own.

This profile requires evidence-before-closure and recursive application at published boundaries. `evaluate_action` binds the pre-action `TargetObligationBinding` and evidence set; authorized deferral changes applicability without proving the original obligation fulfilled. Internal algorithms may remain opaque.

This profile chooses manual/agentic walkthrough, supported-path negative proof, scenario and installed-dev evidence, dogfooding and release boundaries. Their local conditions remain binding; the method/actor cause distinction does not itself decide conformance.

This profile chooses method-folder conventions, Product/self-host boundaries, reading routes and ramp-up questions. The Product supplies concrete bindings; these routes adopt no unselected domain profile and require no unrelated member.
